title: External models: the FMU bundle's invariants and the catalog's admission of an external model
note: FX1-FX5: the FMU's energy balance at its own resolutions, its claim boundary, finiteness, and the catalog's archive-identity and authority rules.

mutations.name: FX1_energy_balance_always
mutations.rationale: an FMU result that does not conserve heat holds its invariant

mutations.name: FX2_claim_boundary_always
mutations.rationale: an FMU claiming authority or measurement holds its claim-boundary invariant

mutations.name: FX3_bound_not_from_resolutions
mutations.rationale: the balance tolerance is widened past the declared resolutions

mutations.name: FX4_archive_identity_unchecked
mutations.rationale: an external bundle naming another archive is admitted

mutations.name: FX5_external_authority_unchecked
mutations.rationale: an external model claiming authority is admitted
